description: This file defines a SwiftUI wrapper for a QR code scanner using VisionKit and a custom DataScannerViewController. It handles QR code recognition, error reporting, and interaction with the parent view through callbacks.

classes.name: Coordinator
classes.description: A delegate class conforming to DataScannerViewControllerDelegate, managing QR code recognition, error reporting, and state handling for the QRScannerView.

methods.name: makeUIViewController
methods.description: Creates and configures the DataScannerViewController instance, including starting the scanning process and handling unsupported devices.

methods.name: updateUIViewController
methods.description: A no-op method required by UIViewControllerRepresentable to update the view controller; currently does nothing.

methods.name: dismantleUIViewController
methods.description: Stops scanning and calls the onDismiss callback when the view controller is dismantled.

methods.name: makeCoordinator
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of the Coordinator class to handle delegate callbacks.

methods.name: reportError
methods.description: Handles reporting errors to the parent view while avoiding duplicate reports.
